item.text: I’ll read the context and pinned source files, then build a single tree from that evidence.

item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
import json
c=json.load(open('context.json'))
for s in c['sources'][2:5]:
 print('\\nFILE '+s['path']+'\\n'+s['text'])
PY"

item.text:
{"ascii":"Reusable Agent Context
|-- Immutable value: AgentContext                         [agentContext.ts]
|   |-- Capture conversation
|   |   |-- fromTrajectory: walk parents from throughEntryId back to fromEntryId
|   |   |   `-- Reverse selected branch into chronological messages
|   |   |       `-- Reject duplicate IDs, cycles, missing entries and off-branch ranges
|   |   `-- fromMessages: wrap panel-owned conversation as a linear trajectory
|   |-- Message structure
|   |   |-- user / assistant / toolResult -> ordered content blocks
|   |   |-- text + pinned sourceRange + named section of text/sourceRange
|   |   `-- assistant may call tools; toolResult must match pending call ID and name
|   |       `-- No reused call IDs, orphan results or unfinished calls at slice end
|   |-- Snapshot = version + source identity + selected range + messages + contentHash
|   |   |-- v1: no source ranges or sections; v2: source ranges; v3: sections
|   |   |-- SHA-256 of canonical descriptor JSON; object keys sorted
|   |   `-- Optional sourceFiles attachments are excluded from descriptor hash
|   `-- Boundary checks
|       |-- 16 MiB input limit; schemas and snapshot hash validated
|       |-- Attached files must match hashes, be referenced and cover selected ranges
|       `-- Clone on capture/export; withMessages produces a newly hashed value
|-- Pinned source constituents                            [agentContextSource.ts]
|   |-- Reference = sourceId + relative path + inclusive startLine/endLine + version
|   |   |-- git -> exact commit hash
|   |   `-- snapshot -> hash of {startLine, lines}; preserves original line offsets
|   |-- Capture through registered corpus bindings         [fileAgentContextSources.ts]
|   |   |-- Explicit revision or binding revision -> resolve commit -> read Git file
|   |   `-- Otherwise read current corpus text
|   |       |-- Git bytes exactly equal HEAD -> use Git reference
|   |       `-- Otherwise -> store immutable snapshot blob
|   |-- Shared backing: agent-context-sources/ [S]
|   |   |-- Used by saved contexts and diagram contexts
|   |   |-- Git reads require regular files; binary text and invalid paths rejected
|   |   `-- Cache up to 16 pinned file reads; failed reads leave cache for retry
|   |-- persist(snapshot)
|   |   `-- Store attachments in [S] -> check every distinct reference -> strip attachments
|   `-- portable(snapshot)
|       `-- Load selected ranges -> embed only selected lines -> replace with snapshot refs
|           `-- Recompute descriptor hash; unrelated file lines stay out of export
|-- Durable library: application-store-wide identity      [agentContextLibrary.ts]
|   |-- create(name, description, group?, context, requestId)
|   |   |-- Plain text -> one user message
|   |   |-- Constituents/sections -> capture source files sequentially -> one user message
|   |   `-- Existing snapshot -> validate imported conversation
|   |       `-- Persist sources through [S] -> saved-agent-context-<requestId>
|   |-- Retry contract
|   |   |-- Same ID + same request hash -> return existing record summary
|   |   |-- Same ID + different request hash -> REQUEST_ID_CONFLICT
|   |   `-- Constituent retry checked before recapture; source changes do not alter retry
|   |-- Saved record                                       [savedAgentContext.ts]
|   |   |-- Snapshot + name + description + creation time + original request hash
|   |   |-- Optional group: set or clear without changing model content/hash
|   |   `-- Optional lineage and comments
|   |-- fork(expectedContentHash, requestId)
|   |   |-- Check parent hash -> copy pinned snapshot into new saved ID
|   |   |-- Record parent ID + parent content hash; inherit description/group unless overridden
|   |   `-- Leave comments on parent; matching retry returns existing fork
|   |-- addComment(expectedContentHash, requestId)
|   |   `-- Append text + timestamp + content hash; identical retry adds no duplicate
|   |-- lineage -> ancestors from root to selected context
|   |   `-- Report pinned-parent hash matches; missing or cyclic ancestry fails
|   |-- read -> compact snapshot + optional separate resolvedSnapshot
|   |   `-- Saved descriptor and its hash remain unchanged by source expansion
|   |-- list -> name/description search -> newest first -> paginated summaries
|   `-- Disk repository: agent-contexts/                   [fileAgentContextRepository.ts]
|       |-- Survives restarts; no canvas or chat binding
|       |-- Create: synced temporary file -> exclusive hard-link publication -> verify request hash
|       `-- Metadata: per-record lock -> synced temporary file -> atomic rename
|           `-- Lock wait expires after 5 seconds; snapshot remains unchanged
|-- Transient uploads: backend lifetime                   [agentContextService.ts]
|   |-- upload(scope, requestId, trajectory) -> validate -> retain context in memory
|   |   |-- Scope = workspaceInstanceId + documentId
|   |   |-- Same scoped request + same content hash -> same receipt
|   |   `-- Different hash -> REQUEST_ID_CONFLICT
|   |-- Receipt: random agent-context ID + hash + source identity + message count
|   |-- Default capacity: 100 contexts / 32 MiB across service records
|   |-- get -> require matching workspace/document; survives reader reconnects
|   `-- resolve(id)
|       |-- saved-agent-context-* -> library.read(id, false): compact saved snapshot
|       `-- Other IDs -> scoped in-memory lookup
|-- Diagram-bound evidence                                [diagramAgentContext.ts]
|   |-- compileDiagramAgentContext(diagram)
|   |   |-- Fingerprint binding + evidence
|   |   |-- Capture original evidence lines as hashed source slices
|   |   `-- Build diagram-context user message: evidence metadata + pinned source ranges
|   |-- Identity: diagramId + compiledFromRevisionId + sourceFingerprint
|   |   `-- Captured evidence is background; each edit supplies the authoritative current diagram
|   |-- Backing representation
|   |   |-- Inline snapshot: supported for old workspaces and portable exports
|   |   `-- Stored: contentHash + backingRecordId; no inline snapshot
|   |       `-- diagram-agent-contexts/ outside canvas checkpoints
|   |           `-- Immutable content-addressed records; source blobs shared through [S]
|   `-- load -> validate snapshot hash, diagram-context agent type and diagram session ID
|       `-- Missing backing storage or mismatched identity -> explicit failure
`-- Model input boundary                                  [agentContext.ts]
    |-- resolveSources: embedded snapshot file first; otherwise supplied source reader
    |   |-- Identical references share one pending read per resolution
    |   |-- Range -> path:line-range header + selected text
    |   |-- Expanded source text capped at 16 MiB; split into blocks of <= 1,000,000 characters
    |   `-- Preserve message/section order; return new snapshot and hash without source refs
    `-- toPiMessages
        |-- Reject unresolved source ranges
        |-- Render sections with labeled opening/closing text boundaries
        `-- Preserve assistant tool calls; imported assistant provenance has zero usage
            `-- Provenance does not select the model for the next run"}
